chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Indeed, these hearts get weary just as bodies get weary, so seek for them the rare and beautiful sayings of wisdom.

key_terms.الْقُلُوبَ: hearts (plural of heart, referring to the spiritual center)
key_terms.تَمَلُّ: get weary/bored (from the root for weariness or satiety)
key_terms.طَرَائِفَ: rare, exquisite, or novel things (plural of tarīf)

ai.seo_question: How to refresh the heart and prevent spiritual weariness according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) draws an analogy between the physical weariness of the body and the spiritual or mental fatigue of the heart, advising the pursuit of 'tarā'if al-hikmah' (rare, exquisite, or novel wisdom) to refresh the soul. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights the necessity of continuous intellectual and spiritual engagement to prevent the heart from becoming dull, emphasizing that wisdom is not static but requires diverse and profound insights to sustain spiritual vitality. This concept underscores the dynamic nature of the human soul, which requires varied stimuli to maintain its connection with the Divine.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 91. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The hearts get weary as bodies get weary; so look for beautiful wise sayings for them (to dispel their weariness).
